mapper.sql: n.del_flag = 0 AND n.publish_status = 1 AND (n.effective_time IS NULL OR n.effective_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (n.expiration_time IS NULL OR n.expiration_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND ( n.publish_scope = 0 OR (n.publish_scope = 1 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_notice_org no INNER JOIN sys_user_org uo ON uo.org_id = no.org_id AND uo.tenant_id = no.tenant_id WHERE no.notice_id = n.notice_id AND no.tenant_id = n.tenant_id AND uo.user_id = #{userId} )) )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_notice n WHERE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_notice_read_record r WHERE r.notice_id = n.notice_id AND r.tenant_id = n.tenant_id AND r.user_id = #{userId} )
